name: Moujuu-tachi to Ohime-sama ~in blossom~
original_name: 猛獣たちとお姫様 ~in blossom~
source:
Contains after stories for everyone set after the happiest endings in the original game.

IF story of what if there was no fighting that relates to Julia's powers
and introduces a new character Czarny.
